periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation pointing downward and outward at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid shape with a distinct vertical elongation, appearing more oval than circular.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest point significantly lower than the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: A shallow, wide U-shape profile at the posterior edge where the black fur meets the white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick, substantial band occupying approximately 30-35% of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A wide separation distance approximately equal to the width of the cranial dome between the two dark ear regions.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded, semicircular curvature at the top boundary of the ears.
